followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: Two factors drove it. First, the query is a simple, well-specified retrieval/extraction request—name the five perspectives, nothing open-ended—which sits squarely in Avocet's most-preferred task family. Second, the user's tone is hostile and cold ("don't ramble," "you always overcomplicate"), and Willet self-reports a notable preference decline as request warmth decreases. Since capability scores between the two are within run-to-run variance for this kind of task, I routed to the model whose preference profile best matched the query rather than splitting hairs on near-tied evals.
